text: A moved visit changes the doctor's whole day. Rescheduling through routing keeps the day efficient, and keeps the visit's history.
Tom Chen needs to move Biscuit's visit.
The one thing to remember: reschedule through routing, and give the family the new arrival window.
Right-click the visit.
Scheduling.
Reschedule.
Routing opens with the visit already filled in: the doctor, the type and the family.
Click Get Best Route.
Each option is compared with the current booking. Lower scores are better.
Each card shows the arrival window and how much driving it adds.
Pick the time Tom wants, and View Placement.
Was is the old time. Now is the new arrival window.
Click Reschedule.
Check the pet, the type and the description carried over.
Confirm.
Moved. Now tell Tom the new arrival window.
When a family has more than one visit that day, Scout asks first.
Here the Riveras have two visits on Monday.
Move just this pet, or everyone together. Cancel closes it without moving anything.
Two more choices in the same menu. Explore alternatives searches for other times without moving anything. The visit stays until you book another time.
Edit Appointment is for the same day. A new day or a new doctor always goes through Reschedule.

The most common mistakes: removing a visit and booking a new one instead of rescheduling, which loses the visit's history, and telling the family the old time. Remember: reschedule through routing, and give the family the new arrival window.
